title: CommunityPulseWriteRequest
description: community.pulse-write-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/pulse/items on OpenVibe.Community (community.pulse.write; service tokens only): an item about one of the calling service's own entities, with a title and an absolute http(s) URL. Visibility is public by default; followers requires origin user and X-OV-Subject and is shown only to that person's followers. Private, unlisted and members items are refused. The same ref updates the item. DELETE /api/v1/pulse/items/:service/:type/:id retracts it.

title.description: At most 300 characters once whitespace is collapsed.
